suites.title: Community phone reply speeds
suites.description: Signed TokForge app submissions. The board retains the best submitted score by chip, model, backend and quantization. A configuration can report its best pass or its median. Prompt rates, first-token delays and app-reported peak memory appear where available. Device RAM capacity is separate. Hardware conditions and app versions vary across submissions.
